features.title: 6 AI Tools, One Platform
features.subtitle: Take your product visuals to the next level — no studio or photographer needed.

3dModel.description: Create high-quality 3D models from a single photo. Showcase your products in 360 degrees.
3dModel.tip: Use a white or plain background with clear lighting and a single product. Avoid complex backgrounds.

bgRemove.description: Remove backgrounds instantly. Get clean, professional product images.
bgRemove.tip: Ensure product edges are sharp. High-contrast photos yield better results.

enhance.description: Enhance low-resolution images with AI. Improve details and sharpness.
enhance.tip: Use images at least 256×256 pixels. Very blurry images may have limited improvement.

scene.description: Create professional scenes and environments for your products. Generate lifestyle images.
scene.tip: Products with clean backgrounds work best. We recommend using 'Remove Background' first.

video.description: Create stunning promotional videos from static product photos.
video.tip: Sharp, high-resolution photos produce smoother videos. Minimum 512×512 pixels recommended.

aplus.description: Generate A+ quality product content and visuals for marketplaces.
aplus.tip: Prepare photos from multiple angles. Keep product features prominent.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Renderhane, we take the protection of your personal data very seriously. This privacy policy explains what data is collected when you use our services, how it is used, and how it is protected.
privacy.section1Content:
The following personal data may be collected during your use of our services:

• Identity information: Name, surname, email address
• Account information: Google account details (when signing in via OAuth)
• Usage data: Uploaded images, generated 3D models, processing history
• Payment information: Payment transactions are processed through Iyzico; your credit card details are not stored by us
• Technical data: IP address, browser information, device information
privacy.section2Content:
Collected data is used for the following purposes:

• Providing and improving our services
• Account management and authentication
• Processing payments
• Providing customer support
• Fulfilling legal obligations
privacy.section3Content: Your data is securely stored using industry-standard encryption methods on Supabase (PostgreSQL) and Cloudflare R2 infrastructure. Your uploaded images and generated outputs are hosted with encryption on Cloudflare R2.
privacy.section4Content:
We work with the following third-party service providers to deliver our services:

• Google (OAuth authentication)
• Supabase (database and authentication)
• Cloudflare (content delivery and file storage)
• fal.ai (AI model processing)
• Iyzico (payment infrastructure)
privacy.section5Content:
You have the following rights regarding your personal data:

• Learn whether your personal data is being processed
• Request information about the processing of your data
• Learn the purpose of data processing and whether it is used accordingly
• Request correction or deletion of your personal data

To exercise these rights, please contact us at info@renderhane.com.
privacy.section6Content:
For questions about our privacy policy, please contact us:

Email: info@renderhane.com

kvkk.title: Data Protection Notice (KVKK)
kvkk.intro: In accordance with the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK"), Renderhane, as the data controller, processes your personal data within the scope described below.
kvkk.section1Content:
The Renderhane platform serves as the data controller.

Contact: info@renderhane.com
kvkk.section2Content:
The following personal data is processed through our platform:

• Identity information: Name, surname
• Contact information: Email address
• Account information: Google account ID, profile photo
• Transaction information: Uploaded images, AI processing results, credit usage history
• Payment information: Payment history (credit card details are processed by Iyzico)
• Technical data: IP address, browser and device information, cookie data
kvkk.section3Content:
Your personal data is processed for the following purposes and legal bases:

• Performance of contract: Service delivery, account management, payment processing
• Legitimate interest: Improving service quality, security measures, statistical analysis
• Legal obligation: Tax legislation, regulatory notifications
• Explicit consent: Marketing communications (if applicable)
kvkk.section4Content:
Your personal data may be transferred to the following parties for service delivery:

• Supabase Inc. (USA) — Database and authentication services
• Cloudflare Inc. (USA) — Content delivery and file storage
• fal.ai (USA) — AI model processing services
• Google LLC (USA) — OAuth authentication
• Iyzico (Turkey) — Payment infrastructure

Cross-border data transfers are carried out with adequate protection under KVKK Article 9.
kvkk.section5Content:
• Account information: As long as the account is active
• Transaction history: Until account deletion
• Uploaded images and outputs: Until account deletion
• Payment records: 10 years as required by law
• Technical logs: 6 months
kvkk.section6Content:
Under Article 11 of KVKK, you have the following rights:

a) Learn whether your personal data is being processed
b) Request information if your personal data has been processed
c) Learn the purpose of processing and whether data is used accordingly
d) Know the third parties to whom your personal data has been transferred domestically or abroad
e) Request correction of incomplete or inaccurate personal data
f) Request deletion or destruction of personal data under KVKK Art. 7
g) Request notification of correction and deletion operations to third parties
h) Object to results arising from automated analysis of processed data
i) Claim compensation for damages caused by unlawful processing of personal data
kvkk.section7Content:
To exercise the rights listed above, you may apply through the following methods:

• Email: Send your application with identity verification documents to info@renderhane.com.

Applications will be concluded free of charge within 30 days at the latest. If the process requires additional costs, fees may be charged according to the tariff determined by the Personal Data Protection Board.
